title: Can I Use Avocado Cream Under My Eyes? A Safe How-To
ex: Where you can and cannot use avocado cream around the eyes, how much to apply, and extra care if your cream contains kojic acid.
rt: Can I Use Avocado Cream Under Eyes? Safe Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Can I use avocado cream under eyes? Learn where to apply it around the eye area, how much to use, and why to take extra care with kojic acid creams.
keyword: can I use avocado cream under eyes
quick: Yes, a rice-grain amount of avocado cream can be patted onto the orbital bone and outer eye corners, but keep it off the eyelids and lash line. If the cream contains kojic acid, patch test first, start a few nights a week and stop if it stings.
facts: Under-eye skin is thinner and has fewer oil glands.
Use your ring finger and a rice-grain amount.
Apply 20–30 minutes before bed so it does not travel into eyes.
Kojic acid creams can sting delicate skin, so go slowly.
